sasha: Heads up — onboarding aurora-30k-int3 (quant3) to staging. After a long prefilling session (~28k tokens) with interleaved sparse system prompts, inference outputs diverge vs baseline. KV cache idx/fingerprint drift seen. Repro steps below.

sasha: repro (staging):
```
# checkout model + harness
git checkout -b onboard/aurora-30k-int3
python -m tests.longctx_run --model aurora-30k-int3 --quant quant3 --seed 42 --prefill-file tests/data/long_sparse_mix.txt --max-tokens 30000 --kv-inspect
```

sasha: sample log snippet: 
```
[2026-01-05T14:12:02Z] kv_inspect: shard0 fingerprint 0x1a2b3c4d expected 0x1a2b3c4d
[2026-01-05T14:12:02Z] kv_inspect: shard0 fingerprint_after_prefill 0x1a2b3c4e (mismatch)
[2026-01-05T14:12:02Z] generator: token mismatch at pos 24512 expected 0x73 got 0x6f
```

ravi: do you see drift only on quant3 or also float32?

sasha: only tried quant3 so far. float32 run matches baseline. suspect quantization+rotary interpolation at long offsets.

kelly: can you run `--kv-inspect --dump-keys --dump-fps` and attach the small diffs? also paste the model cfg (rotary base/scale)

sasha: posting config snippet: `rotary_base: 10000.0, pos_scale: 1.0, rotary_interpolation: linear`

sasha: kv dump (trimmed):
```
index 24510: key_hash=0x9f1e, fp=0x7f2a3c
index 24511: key_hash=0x9f1f, fp=0x7f2a3d
index 24512: key_hash=0x9f20, fp=0x7f2a3e -> AFTER_PREFILL fp=0x7f2a3f
```

yvonne: interesting — that looks like a single-off fingerprint bump. Could be prefill alignment vs in-flight streaming order. Did you run with `--preserve-order`?

sasha: I did not. Will re-run with `--preserve-order`.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy aurora-30k-int3 quant3 to staging completed (canary-id: c-20260105-137). :white_check_mark:

ravi: if preserve-order fixes it then likely a race in async prefetch merging keys. If not, try toggling `rotary_interpolation: nearest` — interpolation math sometimes amplifies quant noise at large exponents.

kelly: also try `--kv-window 65536` and `--kv-slot-stride 1` to force full-indexing instead of tiled tiling. If the mismatch disappears, it's tile/stride related.

sasha: running 3 variants now (preserve-order, nearest-interp, full-window). ETA ~30m. I'll post diffs.

yvonne: add a short scripted test that primes with alternating short/long prompts (to mimic interleaving). We had a related case in mag-16k onboarding.

sasha: good call, adding `tests/longctx/interleave_smoke.py` to the run.

ravi: FYI, log a tiny reproducer that prints `kv_index, fingerprint_before, fingerprint_after, token_seq[pos-3:pos+3]` so we can see context.

sasha: will do. thanks — posting results in this thread in ~35m. :coffee:
